Actually it's "挪用公款"? No, it's private deposit, not public funds. It's "诈骗"? He was entrusted to hold deposit, then misappropriated. Could be "诈骗罪" (fraud) or "职务侵占"? He was not a public official. Could be "侵占罪" (embezzlement) under criminal law: "侵占罪" for misappropriation of property entrusted to him. Also "伪造金融票证罪" explicitly mentioned in the second part. So charges: 1) 侵占罪 (maybe "挪用" but that's for public funds). The appropriate is "侵占罪" (embezzlement). 2) 伪造金融票证罪 (for forging bank deposit slip). So answer: [罪名]侵占罪;伪造金融票证罪<eoa>
